purpose: Allocate a service-query precondition checklist over the eighty-six package-83 service-option rows so future query execution requires both capture-policy and query-term authority returns plus explicit query/result governance.

decision: This checklist makes query execution an explicit downstream gate rather than an accidental consequence of having a template. Every row remains locked because there are no authority returns, approved terms, query strings, or service-query authorizations.
